thread:
Harper (Marketing Ops): FYI morning spike — about 26 leads routed to fallback because enrichment didn't populate before claim window. Seeing this mostly from event signups.

Diego (Sales Ops): Oof, reps are getting empty owner alerts. Any idea what's stalling enrichment?

Harper (Marketing Ops): Looks like attachment-heavy submissions + some partner payloads. Enrichment service returns 202 then PATCH at ~9-11s. Claim window is 4s so RR skips.

Fiona (Platform Eng): Two approaches: bump claim window globally (easy) or optimistic soft-assign + reassign (more targeted). I prefer targeted so we don't add latency for all traffic.

Sasha (Growth): Soft-assign sounds better. Reps get visibility quickly, we suppress outreach until enrichment finalizes. Need a clear flag to filter in HS and SFDC.

Diego (Sales Ops): Agree. Also we must avoid duplicate notifications on reassign. Can we suppress task creation while flag is set?

Fiona (Platform Eng): Yes. Proposal config snippet:
```
OPTIMISTIC_SOFT_ASSIGN=true
SOFT_OWNER="Holding - Await Enrich"
ENRICH_PENDING_FLAG=enrich_pending
SUPPRESS_TASKS_WHILE_FLAG=true
SOFT_ASSIGN_TTL_S=1800
WAIT_FOR_ENRICH_MS=10000
```
Flow: immediate soft-assign to Holding - Await Enrich, wait up to 10s for enrichment; if enrichment arrives run RR and reassign, add note "Auto-reassigned after enrichment (prev Holding - Await Enrich)". Emit metrics `lead.soft_assigned` and `lead.reassigned_after_enrich`.

Harper (Marketing Ops): I'll update HubSpot workflow to set `enrich_pending` on intake and include the reassign note text in the PR.

lead-ops-bot: deploy queued: lead-router -> staging (build #1610).

Sasha (Growth): Canary plan: 500 synthetic leads (30% large payloads), run at 3:15pm PT. Monitor: percent_soft_assigned, reassign_success_rate, duplicate_notify_rate, avg_time_to_final_owner. Targets: reassign_success >90%, duplicate_notify <3%.

Fiona (Platform Eng): I'll run the canary and own rollback. Rollback steps: OPTIMISTIC_SOFT_ASSIGN=false, CLAIM_WINDOW_MS=4000, clear `enrich_pending` via backfill if needed. Will post dashboard links + sample IDs here after canary.

Diego (Sales Ops): I'll prepare a short note for SDRs about the Holding queue and a filter for HS/SFDC. Please alert Sales leadership before prod.

Harper (Marketing Ops): Timeline: staging patch now, canary 3:15pm, review 4:00pm, prod 8:30pm if green. Thanks team :thumbsup:
